title: Your Purpose Might Be Quieter Than You Think
core_idea: Purpose may already be present in small moments where you feel most yourself; it unfolds gradually.
text: What if your purpose isn't something you have to find, but something you're already living in small ways? Many spiritual traditions describe the soul as arriving with a quiet intention, not a job title. Notice the moments when time seems to soften, when you help without being asked, when you feel unmistakably like yourself. Those moments may be pointing somewhere. You don't need the whole map today. Purpose can unfold the way a path appears in the dark, one lantern at a time. So follow what feels true, gently, and let the rest reveal itself when it's ready.
description: A gentle reflection on soul purpose: what if it is already showing itself in the small moments when you feel most like yourself?
